title.en: Accounting Standards, Ind AS and IFRS
title.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳು, Ind AS ಮತ್ತು IFRS

heading.en: One rulebook for the whole world?

hook.en: An Indian company raising money abroad must show accounts that foreign investors understand. Accounting standards make this possible.
hook.kn: ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಂಪನಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ಸಾಧ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the meaning and benefits of accounting standards
Know the role of ICAI, Ind AS and IFRS

narration.en: An Indian company raising money abroad must show accounts that foreign investors understand. Accounting standards make this possible.
narration.kn: ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಂಪನಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ಸಾಧ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Accounting standards are written policy documents issued by an expert accounting body, or by the government, covering the recognition, measurement, treatment, presentation and disclosure of accounting transactions. In India the ICAI set up the Accounting Standards Board in April 1977 to formulate them. They reduce alternative treatments, improve comparability and make statements more reliable.
body.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ, ಅಳೆಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಲಿಖಿತ ನೀತಿ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು. ICAI 1977ರಲ್ಲಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡ ಮಂಡಳಿ ರಚಿಸಿತು.

narration.en: Accounting standards are written policy documents issued by an expert accounting body, or by the government, covering the recognition, measurement, treatment, presentation and disclosure of accounting transactions. In India the ICAI set up the Accounting Standards Board in April 1977 to formulate them. They reduce alternative treatments, improve comparability and make statements more reliable.
narration.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ, ಅಳೆಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಲಿಖಿತ ನೀತಿ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು. ICAI 1977ರಲ್ಲಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡ ಮಂಡಳಿ ರಚಿಸಿತು.

body.en: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) are issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) and are used in many countries, so that statements prepared in one country are understood in another. India has converged its standards with IFRS as Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), notified by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs in 2015 and applied in phases to listed and large companies.
body.kn: IFRS ಅನ್ನು ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮಾನದಂಡ ಮಂಡಳಿ (IASB) ಹೊರಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಭಾರತ IFRS ಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಂಡ Ind AS ಅನ್ನು 2015ರಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತಂದಿತು.

problem.en: Two jewellery firms value their closing stock differently: one at cost, the other at market price, which is higher. What problem does this cause and what is the remedy?

steps.en: Profits of the two firms are not comparable, and the second firm shows an unrealised profit.
A user cannot judge which firm is doing better.
An accounting standard on inventories prescribes a single rule: lower of cost and net realisable value. Both firms must follow it.

answer.en: Lack of comparability; the remedy is a common accounting standard.
